mission: GREEN backlog item (issue #315, owner t729u 26 Nov, content-pipeline ops/decisions.md L699, moved up by t756u L714): a read-only admin page for the existing rate-limit status counts, behind the admin session, through the existing admin proxy. Web only, with tests and a PRODUCT_LOG line. No API change.

impacts.reason: GET only, fixed backend path /admin/rate-limit/status through proxyAdminJson (admin session required), force-dynamic.
Read-only admin page under the protected layout: counting-since time, three counts, window table, Refresh; notes counts are per API process and reset on every deploy.
RateLimitStatus type mirroring the API response and fetchRateLimitStatus().
One Rate Limits entry in admin navigation and the command palette.
Route uses the fixed path and only exports GET and dynamic; page renders counts and started_at, Refresh is the only action, session-expired state.

dependencies: option D (#314) delivered or held first: one delivery at a time
impact.deployment_impact: Vercel staging web rebuilds. No collector rollout, no Railway deployment, no fleet change.

recovery.procedure: Native revert PR of this merge with its own mission file; the page and route disappear.
recovery.trigger: The route answers without an admin session, is served from a shared cache, or the staging delivery verify fails.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change.

verification.observation_window: This merge's staging delivery verify, then a signed-out request to /api/admin/rate-limit/status returns 401 and /admin/rate-limit redirects to admin login; the owner confirms the signed-in page.
